name: White Family Rotary treadle sewing machine restoration

mentions.name: White Family Rotary treadle sewing machine restoration
mentions.description: This project restores an antique White rotary shuttle treadle sewing machine to working order: installing a new treadle belt, cleaning removable parts (presser foot, bobbin mechanism) in an ultrasonic cleaner, oiling, and touching up the gold decals on the treadle table with oil paint, with plans to try quilting on it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been cleaning up an antique treadle sewing machine (a White rotary shuttle machine; still unsure of the exact manufacturing date but it seems to be a Family Rotary).

evidence.value: I've been cleaning up an antique treadle sewing machine (a White rotary shuttle machine; still unsure of the exact manufacturing date but it seems to be a Family Rotary).
